title: Prometheus flashcards: for the Prometheus Certified Associate (PCA) exam
releaseBlockers: no source states the PCA's own question count or pass mark (the 60 questions and 75% are the Linux Foundation's generic multiple-choice figures)
description: Observability, Prometheus, PromQL, instrumentation and alerting for the PCA exam, from the Prometheus documentation and the CNCF curriculum: every idea explained before it is tested. Builds on the Kubernetes (KCNA) deck.

glossary.SIGHUP: the Unix signal used to trigger a Prometheus configuration reload
glossary.HELP: the exposition format's metric docstring comment line
glossary.TYPE: the exposition format's metric type comment line
glossary.UTF: Unicode Transformation Format, as in UTF-8
glossary.FOR: an alerting rule's clause requiring a condition to hold for a duration before it fires
glossary.PCA: Prometheus Certified Associate, the exam this deck prepares for
glossary.ALERTS: the synthetic time series Prometheus stores for pending and firing alerts
glossary.RE2: the regular expression engine Prometheus uses
glossary.IEEE: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, as in IEEE 754, the floating-point arithmetic standard

sourceShort: the Prometheus documentation and the CNCF curriculum

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 468 cards against the Prometheus documentation, the OpenTelemetry documentation and the CNCF curriculum, for accuracy and plain language, and every PromQL expression against the functions and operators pages
checks.result: 13 wrong answers or explanations, 26 unsupported claims, 5 ambiguous cards, 8 unclear ones and 63 minor issues were fixed; a third check confirmed all 13 wrong cards are now right. The architecture diagram was redrawn without third-party logos.
